visualCharacteristics.purpose: Two dependent dropdowns (review type, then product) with a submit button that navigates to the chosen reviews page

contentPattern.structure: Optional keyed rows: Type label | placeholder; Filter label | placeholder; Submit | button label. Every other row is one review type: type name (text or link) | list of product links

usage: Reviews hub and product reviews pages (10 pages).
reuseGuidance: Reuse for the same content pattern; background colour comes from section metadata Style (forest, green, bright-green, eggshell, neon, white, black).
